# Official status parsing fixtures

These are public status-page responses captured by the original Pulse project
and reused to check its 1.9.0 service-status parsers on Windows. No account
credentials or private usage records are present.

Source: https://github.com/qunqin24/Pulse/tree/v1.9.0/Tests

Copyright (c) 2026 qunqin24. Original repository code and fixtures are distributed
under Apache License 2.0; see `licenses/Pulse-Apache-2.0.txt` and
`licenses/NOTICE-Pulse.txt` in this repository. Fixture assertions compare the
publisher’s reported history and uptime rather than manufacturing availability.
